import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { inspectAccessViews } from '/private/tmp/umf-temporal-inspection/src/compilation/admission/access/index.ts';
const cases=JSON.parse(readFileSync('/private/tmp/umf-temporal-inspection/tests/rust-core/fixtures/access-inspection/cases.json','utf8'));
const document=cases.cases.find((row:any)=>row.id==='date-instant-local').request.document;
for (const module of document.modules) for (const element of module.elements) if (element.kind==='field' || element.kind==='record') element.name=element.id;
const selected=document.modules.flatMap((module:any)=>module.elements.filter((element:any)=>element.kind==='record').map((element:any)=>({module:module.id,element:element.id})));
const request={document,selected,bindings:[],sourceId:'logical'};
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({request,result:inspectAccessViews(document,selected,[],'logical')},null,2)+'\n');
